Hey, just in case you didn't know, you can align the header in the middle of the site and stop it from being stretched/cropped by replacing your current #header like this:

Current #header:

#header {
 background: url( http://i.imgur.com/OEwyXbI.jpg ) no-repeat;
height: 220px;
background-size: 100% 100%;}
}

 

Replace with:

#header {
 background: url( http://i.imgur.com/OEwyXbI.jpg ) no-repeat;
 height: 270px;
 background-position: 50% 20%;
}

 

Edit: Also, there seems to be a bracket too much in your #header, which could cause you problems.
